name: prompt-polish
description: Cleans up voice-dictated prompts before the agent sees them, teaches the fix in a one-line tip, and can rewrite vague prompts with a stronger model.

isEnabled.title: Enabled
isEnabled.description: Turn the rewrite on or off without uninstalling.

fastModel.title: Fast model
fastModel.description: Model that fixes grammar and classifies each prompt (alias or full id).

fastEffort.title: Fast model effort
fastEffort.description: Thinking effort for the fast model.

improveModel.title: Improve model
improveModel.description: Model used when you choose to improve a vague prompt.

improveEffort.title: Improve model effort
improveEffort.description: Thinking effort for the improve model.

isAskingWhenUnsure.title: Ask when unsure
isAskingWhenUnsure.description: Show a dialog, with the recommended choice first, only when the fast model is not confident what to do with a prompt.

isAutoImproving.title: Auto-improve
isAutoImproving.description: Run the improve model automatically when the fast model confidently recommends it. Off by default: you ask by starting a prompt with "improve:".

askBelowConfidence.title: Ask below confidence
askBelowConfidence.description: Ask which action to take only when the fast model's confidence (0-100) is below this. Lower it to be asked less; 0 never asks.

minWords.title: Minimum words
minWords.description: Prompts shorter than this are left alone.

minPastedChars.title: Pasted characters that block rewriting
minPastedChars.description: A prompt containing at least this many pasted characters is left completely alone.

maxWords.title: Maximum words
maxWords.description: Longer prompts are treated as deliberately typed and left alone.

statusSeconds.title: Status seconds
statusSeconds.description: How long the 'polish:' status stays visible.
